heroHeadline: North Korea Condemns US Approval of South Korea's Nuclear Submarine Program as Destabilizing
heroSubtitle: North Korea on September 28, 2026 condemned the US decision to approve South Korea's nuclear-powered submarine program, warning it increases regional instability. The rebuke follows a series of escalatory moves: KCNA confirmed North Korea's September 20 double SRBM launch tested an upgraded hypersonic-glide warhead, and Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui declared on September 24 that North Korea's nuclear status is 'irreversible... and will remain unchanged forever.'
footerNote: Data sourced from US/ROK official reports, KCNA, UN panels, IAEA, and institutional analyses. North Korea does not publish national statistics — economic figures are estimates with wide uncertainty ranges.
